reason: New current evidence changes the UAU/Uattzy tariff-priority assessment. A first-party Uattzy July 2026 publication states that tariffs are unified across the proprietary network according to charging type. A contemporaneous specialist report gives the candidate class prices, but the current Uattzy FAQ still says connector prices/additional costs are shown in-app and can vary with power, session duration and bay occupancy. Therefore Uattzy must be investigated ahead of station-level CPOs as a class-wide candidate, but no network/class tariff may be promoted until exact Quick/Fast/Ultra Fast class boundaries, applicability and current exceptions are resolved from first-party evidence.

changes.tariffChannel: direct Uattzy app/RFID and direct POS must remain distinct; roaming eMSP excluded
positiveEvidence: First-party Uattzy publication: from 1 July 2026 the proprietary-network tariff is unified across the network according to charging type, with no activation cost and no per-minute charging fee.
Specialist E-Ricarica report dated 3 July 2026 supplies candidate values: app/RFID Quick 0.57 EUR/kWh, Fast+Ultra Fast 0.67; POS Quick 0.61, Fast+Ultra Fast 0.72.
Current Uattzy site confirms UAU is both CPO and eMSP and that its app, RFID, QR/POS and roaming channels are distinct.

Historical first-party GASGAS/Uattzy material explicitly identifies a Quick product at 2x22 kW and a Fast product at 50 kW, useful as discovery evidence but insufficient to prove all current class boundaries.
negativeEvidence: Current Uattzy FAQ says the app exposes the tariff at each connector and any additional costs, and says prices can vary based on delivered power, session duration and bay-occupancy time.
No current first-party text retrieved in this run defines the exact complete Quick/Fast/Ultra Fast kW boundaries for every active EVSE.
Do not map the candidate tariff grid to UTZ/ESH/GAS EVSEs until exact class boundaries and any station/connector exceptions are proven.
Do not use roaming eMSP prices as direct Uattzy prices.
changes.blockage: Exact current class-boundary definitions and reconciliation of the July unified-network announcement with the current FAQ variability wording are still missing.
changes.resumeCondition: Retrieve first-party tariff PDF/app/backend metadata that defines Quick/Fast/Ultra Fast boundaries and exceptions; then deterministically map all UTZ/ESH/GAS source EVSEs by connector/power and channel.
changes.confidence: high that a class-wide tariff announcement exists; medium on the numerical grid until first-party tariff media is retrieved; insufficient for rankable promotion
